source: Original Device Hub window observations; cropped canvas derivatives, not direct simulator framebuffers.
themeAxis: Simulator Appearance Light/Dark with matching automatic page backgrounds (some Light cases explicitly select the identical light palette). Independent page/meta controls are recorded separately.

simulatorControls.status: Observed Device Hub settings, not iOS material kernel parameters

units: Body angles: clockwise in canvas; viewport: actual CSS px; native frames: XCTest points; crops: original window pixels. No physical mm.
limits: Window canvas observations, not direct simulator framebuffers; WebP is lossy.
Content layout groups do not collapse the four observed body angles or rotation history.
Closed 180 degrees retained the preceding landscape scene in this clockwise sequence.
Some integer innerHeight readings are one CSS pixel below the earlier reference; original values are preserved.
Default XCTest applicationFrame can target the other display; use the WebView/component frames and actual canvas separately.
Original private evidence is not required to validate the public derivative bytes; its absence cannot establish native acceptance.
Simulator artwork and Safari UI are not relicensed under MIT; redistribution rights remain unconfirmed.
Additional cross-fold attempts retained Open top chrome on a Closed exterior; rejected outside the accepted 48-case matrix. Restart/restore a correct baseline before acceptance.

triggers.shellPalette: System Appearance changes glass/glyph treatment independently from the page canvas. Opposing theme-color hints did not override page-driven appearance in these controls. A dark page under Light is not a substitute for system Dark.
triggers.chrome: A real native downward scroll compacts; reversing upward expands at nonzero scrollY. Top resets require native up after fold/rotation settling; fixture scrollTo alone did not compact the observed Open shell. Accepted clean Closed case expanded at Y=545 with a 382x580 viewport after reversing upward. Open two/one tab reversals expanded at Y=509/Y=562.
triggers.tabStrip: Visible only in Open expanded navigation with at least two tabs. One/two/three were observed; Closed with two and Open compact hide the extra row. No tab strip means one page tab, not zero browser tabs.
